title: 3 Dark Psychology Tricks People Use On You
hook: If someone stares at your forehead while you speak, they are doing this on purpose.

scenes.text: If someone stares at your forehead while you speak, they are doing this on purpose.

scenes.text: It makes you feel deeply insecure and completely shatters your train of thought.

scenes.text: Second is the silent pause. When they want you to over-explain a lie, they simply stay quiet and keep looking at you.
scenes.visual_prompt: two shadowy figures across an interrogation table, dramatic smoky lighting, cinema noir style, ultra sharp 8k vertical

scenes.text: Humans naturally hate silence, so they rush to fill the gap with confessions.

scenes.text: And the most dangerous one? Artificial scarcity of affection. They pull away to make you obsess.

scenes.text: Remember, aware minds are impossible to control. Drop a follow if you refuse to be manipulated.
